snippet.title: Sportvida CyberDash - Official Update Trailer | Upload VR Showcase 2025
snippet.description: Sportvida CyberDash is a VR running game that delivers both stress relief and thrilling challenges. Set in a high-speed, futuristic world of light and technology, you’ll embark on an intense adventure where sprinting, dodging, and smashing obstacles offer an unparalleled sense of release. Check out the Sportvida CyberDash trailer to see what to expect with the new update, which includes the recording camera tool sets. Sportvida CyberDash is available on Meta Quest and Steam VR.
